title: #opera #lascala #sondraradvanovsky #greenscreenvideo
transcript: I'm summoning opera TikTok I am not an opera buff by any stretch of imagination though I have such respect for the art form and several years ago I took my mother to see Anna Bolena at the Lyric Opera and it starred Sondra Radvanovsky I hope im pronouncing her name correctly and she blew me away so the other day just randomly this YouTube interview came up of her talking about her origin story her career path and I was watching it just to learn more about you know who she is as an artist she just seems really cool very talented very confident in her talent and like where she fits in the art form I just loved everything that she had to say but then this question came up and I was like oh what is the tea you just gotta watch um is there a real difference between working in American houses and working in European houses is the level of professionalism the same across all of these great houses or do you do are there differences La Scala yes is one opera house that I will not be singing again ever again just because of the level of professionalism yeah yeah and I take my art seriously what is the tea what's going on over at La Scala in Milan something's happening over there I gotta know
